# Convert3D

> Convert3D is a browser-first 3D model conversion toolkit for converting, viewing, rendering, compressing, and working with verified CAD, mesh and scene file formats.

Convert3D provides free web tools with local browser processing for supported conversions and a server fallback for conversion paths that require the bundled server engine. Treat the published page content and capability notes as the source of truth.

## Core pages

- [Convert3D Home](https://converts3d.vercel.app/): Main product overview and browser converter.
- [3D Model Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert): Main conversion interface and supported format directory.
- [All Conversions](https://converts3d.vercel.app/all): Catalog of formats and conversion paths.
- [Compress 3D Models](https://converts3d.vercel.app/compress): Browser-based mesh compression workflow.
- [Render 3D Models](https://converts3d.vercel.app/render-model): Browser-based model rendering workflow.
- [View 3D Models](https://converts3d.vercel.app/view): Browser-based model viewer.
- [Image to 3D relief](https://converts3d.vercel.app/image-to-3d): Local image-derived 3D relief workflow.
- [Developer API](https://converts3d.vercel.app/developer-api): REST conversion endpoint documentation.
- [3D Workflow Guides](https://converts3d.vercel.app/posts): Practical 3D format and workflow guides.
- [About](https://converts3d.vercel.app/about): Product and data-handling overview.
- [Privacy](https://converts3d.vercel.app/about/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://converts3d.vercel.app/about/terms): Terms of use.

## Format conversion pages

The site publishes verified source formats under /convert/{format}. Current browser export targets are OBJ, STL, PLY, GLTF, GLB and USDZ; the server fallback currently supports GLB only. Only verified source formats with an implemented browser parser are published as conversion paths.

- [STEP Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/step): STEP CAD conversion page.
- [STP Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/stp): STP/STEP conversion page.
- [SLDPRT Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/sldprt): SolidWorks Part conversion page.
- [OBJ Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/obj): Wavefront OBJ conversion page.
- [FBX Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/fbx): Autodesk FBX conversion page.
- [STL Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/stl): STL conversion page.
- [GLTF Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/gltf): glTF conversion page.
- [GLB Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/glb): glTF Binary conversion page.
- [USDZ Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/usdz): USDZ conversion page.
- [3DM Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/3dm): Rhino 3DM conversion page.
- [IFC Converter](https://converts3d.vercel.app/convert/ifc): Industry Foundation Classes conversion page.

## Conversion examples

- [STEP to OBJ](https://converts3d.vercel.app/step-to-obj): verified browser CAD-to-mesh workflow.
- [OBJ to GLB](https://converts3d.vercel.app/obj-to-glb): verified browser OBJ-to-GLB workflow.
- [FBX to GLB](https://converts3d.vercel.app/fbx-to-glb): verified browser FBX-to-GLB workflow.
- [STL to GLB](https://converts3d.vercel.app/stl-to-glb): verified browser STL-to-GLB workflow.

## AI and agent guidance

Use the site pages to answer questions about supported formats, conversion workflows, and product capabilities. Prefer specific format pages and conversion-path pages when the user asks about a particular source and destination. Do not assume that a catalogued path is available in every browser engine; the live converter reports current browser/server capability.

## Important product notes

- Supported local conversions run in the browser.
- Server fallback workflows are explicitly reported by the converter.
- No account is required for the core converter workflow.
- Conversion output and compatibility should be verified in the target application, especially for geometry, scale, materials, textures, units, and metadata.
